description: Import and browse novels, and check all opted-in sources each minute with source-specific chapter checkers.
name: Novels

normalizeInput.set: ${ if (.chapter_from != null and .chapter_to != null and .chapter_to < .chapter_from) then error("Last chapter must be greater than or equal to first chapter") else . + {novel_url:(.novel_url | rtrimstr("/"))} end }

parseSeries.set:
${
  {
    seriesPage: (
      .seriesHtml
      | split("data-page=\"") | .[1] | split("\"") | .[0]
      | split(""") | join("\"") | fromjson
    ),
    novelUrl: .novel_url,
    novelSlug: (.novel_url | split("/") | map(select(. != "")) | last),
    chapterFrom: (.chapter_from // 1),
    chapterTo: (.chapter_to // 5),
    stored: .stored,
    autoUpdateExplicit: (.auto_update != null),
    autoUpdate: (if .auto_update != null then (.auto_update) else (.stored.auto_update // false) end),
    lastDownloaded: (.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0),
    chapters: [],
    downloaded: []
  }
}

output.as:
$input + {
  lastDownloaded: (if $chapter.chapterNumber > $input.lastDownloaded then $chapter.chapterNumber else $input.lastDownloaded end),
  downloaded: (
    $input.downloaded + [{
      number: $chapter.chapterNumber,
      slug: $chapter.slug,
      name: $chapter.name,
      url: ("https://brightnovels.com/series/" + $input.novelSlug + "/" + $chapter.slug),
      body: (
        $output | split("data-page=\"") | .[1] | split("\"") | .[0]
        | split(""") | join("\"") | fromjson
        | .props.chapter.content
        | split("&") | join("&")
        | split("<") | join("<")
        | split(">") | join(">")
        | split(""") | join("\"")
        | split("'") | join("'")
        | split("'") | join("'")
        | split(" ") | join(" ")
      )
    }]
  )
}

result.set:
${
  {
    title: .series.title,
    auto_update: .autoUpdate,
    auto_update_explicit: .autoUpdateExplicit,
    last_downloaded_chapter: .lastDownloaded,
    author: .series.user.name,
    synopsis: .series.description,
    cover: ("https://brightnovels.com/storage/" + .series.cover.path),
    source: .novelUrl,
    chapter_from: .chapterFrom,
    chapter_to: .chapterTo,
    chapters: .downloaded
  }
}

ferrisflow.description: Check only the lowest chapter beyond the saved checkpoint from linked sources.

parseChapterCandidates.set:
${ . + {chapters:(
  (
    .chapterLinks
    | map(select(contains("chapter-")))
    | map(select(.number > ($input.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0)))
    | map({path:.,number:(split("chapter-")|.[1]|split("-")|.[0]|split("?")|.[0]|tonumber)})
    | map({number:.number,name:("Chapter " + (.number|tostring)),url:$input.origin + .path})
  )
  +
  (
    .chapterLinks
    | map(select(not contains("chapter-") and (ascii_downcase|contains("chapter"))))
    | map(select(.number > ($input.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0)))
    | map({path:.,number:(ascii_downcase|split("chapter")|.[1]|split("/")|.[1]|split("?")|.[0]|tonumber)})
    | map({number:.number,name:("Chapter " + (.number|tostring)),url:$input.origin + .path})
  )
  +
  (
    .absoluteChapterLinks
    | map(select(contains("chapter-")))
    | map(select(.number > ($input.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0)))
    | map({path:.,number:(split("chapter-")|.[1]|split("-")|.[0]|split("?")|.[0]|tonumber)})
    | map({number:.number,name:("Chapter " + (.number|tostring)),url:.path})
  )
  +
  (
    .absoluteChapterLinks
    | map(select(not contains("chapter-") and (ascii_downcase|contains("chapter"))))
    | map(select(.number > ($input.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0)))
    | map({path:.,number:(ascii_downcase|split("chapter")|.[1]|split("/")|.[1]|split("?")|.[0]|tonumber)})
    | map({number:.number,name:("Chapter " + (.number|tostring)),url:.path})
  ) | reverse | if length > 0 then [.[0]] else [] end
)} }

prepareChapters.set: ${ . + {chapters:(.chaptersResponse.chapters | map(select(.is_premium != true)) | reverse | map(select(.number > ($input.stored.last_downloaded_chapter // 0))) | if length > 0 then [.[0]] else [] end | map({number:.number,name:.name,url:($input.novel_url + "/" + .slug)}))} }

ferrisflow.description: Check the next sequential Mistmint Haven chapter and report it only when accessible.

analyzeChapter.set: ${ . + {chapterLocked:(.chapterHtml | contains("\\\"status\\\":401")),chapterAccess:(if (.chapterHtml | contains("\\\"status\\\":401")) then "premium" else "free" end), chapterName:(if (.chapterHtml | contains("\\\"status\\\":401")) then "" else "Chapter " + (.nextChapter | tostring) end)} }

returnCandidates.set: ${ {source:.novel_url,source_site:"mistminthaven.com",title:.stored.title,author:.stored.author,synopsis:.stored.synopsis,cover:.stored.cover,auto_update:.stored.auto_update,last_downloaded_chapter:.stored.last_downloaded_chapter, checked_chapter_number:.nextChapter,checked_chapter_access:.chapterAccess,is_premium:(.chapterAccess == "premium"), has_new_chapters:((.chapterAccess == "free") and (.chapterName != "")), chapters:(if .chapterAccess == "free" then [{number:.nextChapter,name:.chapterName,url:.chapterUrl,is_premium:false}] else [] end), premium_chapters:(if .chapterAccess == "premium" then [.nextChapter] else [] end)} }

ferrisflow.description: Download the next accessible Mistmint Haven chapter, extract its text, and save it.

output.as: ${ $input + {last_downloaded_chapter:(if ($output | contains("\\\"status\\\":401")) then ($input.last_downloaded_chapter // 0) elif $chapter.number > ($input.last_downloaded_chapter // 0) then $chapter.number else ($input.last_downloaded_chapter // 0) end),downloaded:(if ($output | contains("\\\"status\\\":401")) then $input.downloaded else ($input.downloaded + [{number:$chapter.number,name:$chapter.name,url:$chapter.url,body:($output | split("1f:T") | .[1] | split("self.__next_f.push([1,\"") | .[1] | split("\"])") | .[0] | ("\"" + . + "\"" | fromjson))}]) end)} }
